Find the reward named in the briefing, then enter the room full of it. Each completed maze adds to your trophy shelf. New maze mechanics arrive gradually and combine in later levels. Every generated maze has a proven route.

Up or W walks forward; Down or S steps back; Left/A and Right/D turn. Click the left or right third to turn, the middle to walk, or the lower middle to step back. Enter dismisses a briefing. T opens your trophy shelf.

Step on a colored pad to open its matching door. Slightly unusual carpet may hide a portal. An elevator connects the two floors. Touching a flip stone puts you on the ceiling: floor pads and elevators become unreachable, and ceiling pads become available. Light bulbs toggle the blackout.

The marble can block your way but will roll away. The paint snail changes the walls. Corridor visitors may speak or help. Restart maze keeps the same maze; your cleared mazes and collected trophies save locally. A reopened unfinished maze starts from its entrance.

The command bar offers Restart maze, Trophy shelf and Who's who. Music, Sound and Motion obey PlaySuite's master switches. Reduced motion snaps the camera instead of gliding, bobbing, rolling or flashing; moving inhabitants continue to follow the same rules.
